name: File Viewer
title: File Viewer (Preview 200+ File Formats)
short_desc: Browser-side previewer for Office, PDF, CAD and 3D files
icon_note: mdi/file-eye-outline (neutral; upstream logo reuse not checked)
angle: A self-hosted universal file previewer: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF/OFD, CAD, 3D models, images, archives and code rendered entirely in the visitor's browser, plus a document-compare page and an iframe embed mode for your own apps. Static nginx, no database, no variables, no conversion backend - the lightest template of the batch (zero inputs).
notes: Official flyfishdev/file-viewer:3.3.4 image; only change is nginx listen 80 -> 8080 (IPv4+IPv6) via sed in a wrapper Dockerfile (build fails if the sed doesn't match). No variables at all, so var-descriptions JSON is empty. Healthcheck path / (the upstream /healthz returns 204, which Railway doesn't count). Files are processed client-side, nothing is uploaded; the demo has no access control. Optional DWG/DWF CAD runtime upstream is AGPL-3.0. Not affiliated with File Viewer.
